claims_to_check: Kestrix detection on all Phase 4 test pairs is at or above opengrep's, with the paired bootstrap interval reported.
Kestrix alerts per KLOC on fixed (after) files over all Phase 4 test pairs stay within the dev interval [0.23, 0.74] and below opengrep's.
Go: gosec is expected to detect more than Kestrix (as on dev, through its untainted file-path and command checks); reported as measured.
Per-language numbers are reported with their intervals; C# and Kotlin have too few in-scope pairs to support a claim.
Reported as measured whatever the outcome; no rule or threshold changes follow this run.
metrics: detection (family match within 3 lines of a changed line), fix-aware, fix-weighted, alerts per KLOC on after-files; 95% percentile bootstrap, 1000 resamples of whole repositories
